companies.name: Raymond James Financial
notes: Fiscal year ends September 30. Tangible equity here does not net deferred tax liabilities on intangibles, so TBV per share runs slightly below the company's reported figure.

companies.name: LPL Financial
notes: LPL reports revenue before advisor payouts, which it books as a separate expense rather than compensation. Compensation ratio and pre-tax margin are not comparable and are left blank.
LPL's goodwill and intangibles exceed its equity, so tangible book value is negative and return on tangible equity is left blank.

companies.name: Ameriprise Financial
notes: Ameriprise does not tag a total compensation expense, so the compensation ratio is blank.
Ameriprise tags goodwill and intangibles only in its annual report, so tangible equity uses the latest year-end values.
Ameriprise's equity is reduced by large unrealized losses on its insurance investment portfolio, which pushes its return on equity far above the other firms.

preferred.note: Morgan Stanley stopped tagging preferred stock separately. $9.75bn is total equity less common equity (book value per share times shares) from the Q2 2026 earnings release. Update it if the company issues or redeems preferred stock.
